status: sealed before running experiments E2 and E3
carried_lesson: Every comparison below is conditioned on BOTH cells being stable. EP-0001's P7 failed because the baseline policy diverged and the criterion was undefined (lesson M-4). Diverged cells are a separate category and their mean JCT is not used in any ratio (M-5).

E2.question: Is there a gang-need-mix threshold theta* where ServerFilling-SRPT overtakes greedy SRPT, and is theta* independent of load?
E2.mix_family: P(need = 2^i) proportional to theta^i for needs (1,2,4,8,16,32,64)

E3.question: Was EP-0001's finding that estimation error barely matters an artifact of the noise parameterisation? Mean-unbiased lognormal noise shrinks the median estimate by exp(-sigma^2/2); median-unbiased noise makes sigma pure spread.

predictions.claim: A mix threshold exists between theta=0.4 and theta=0.8: at rho=0.85 greedy SRPT wins at theta=0.4 and ServerFilling-SRPT wins at theta=0.8
predictions.criterion: ratio sf_srpt/srpt > 1 at theta=0.4 AND < 1 at theta=0.8 (both stable)
predictions.falsified_if: either leg fails or either cell is unstable

predictions.claim: The crossover position is insensitive to load: the smallest theta at which sf_srpt wins differs by at most one grid step between rho=0.7 and rho=0.95
predictions.falsified_if: the crossover moves by two or more grid steps
predictions.hypothesis: H11 (the advantage is a mix effect, not a load effect)

predictions.claim: The sf_srpt/srpt mean-JCT ratio decreases monotonically in theta at rho=0.85 over the stable cells
predictions.criterion: no increase greater than 1 standard error between consecutive theta values

predictions.claim: Greedy SRPT's divergence at rho=0.85 sets in between theta=1.0 and theta=1.6, and it is stable at theta <= 0.8
predictions.criterion: srpt stable at theta in {0.4,0.6,0.8}, diverged at theta=1.6
predictions.hypothesis: H4 stability region is the binding constraint

predictions.claim: EASY backfill never diverges at any theta for rho <= 0.95
predictions.criterion: no diverged easy_backfill cell in E2
predictions.hypothesis: H13 backfill is chosen for worst-case robustness

predictions.claim: FCFS at rho=0.85 is stable at theta=0.4 and diverged at every theta >= 1.0
predictions.criterion: fcfs stable at theta=0.4, diverged at theta in {1.0,1.25,1.6,2.0}
predictions.hypothesis: measured rho_max 0.918 / 0.730 / 0.646 extrapolates along the mix axis

predictions.claim: EASY backfill is never the best policy in any stable E2 cell: min(srpt, sf_srpt) always beats it
predictions.criterion: for every stable cell, min(mean_jct(srpt), mean_jct(sf_srpt)) < mean_jct(easy_backfill)
predictions.falsified_if: backfill is best in any stable cell

predictions.claim: Under median-unbiased noise, easy_backfill's mean JCT is monotone non-decreasing in sigma; EP-0001's non-monotonic result was the mean-unbiased confound
predictions.criterion: no decrease greater than 1 standard error between consecutive sigma values, est_mode=median

predictions.claim: Even with pure spread (median-unbiased) at sigma=3, greedy SRPT still beats easy_backfill
The systematic underestimation in mean-unbiased noise was HELPING easy_backfill: at sigma=3 backfill is worse under median-unbiased noise than under mean-unbiased noise
predictions.criterion: mean_jct(easy_backfill, median, sigma=3) > mean_jct(easy_backfill, mean, sigma=3)
predictions.falsified_if: median mode is equal or better

declared_unknowns: whether theta* also depends on the service-time distribution (exponential only here)
whether the srpt divergence onset theta is sharp or gradual (7 grid points only)
whether sf_srpt's mean JCT is monotone in theta (not predicted)
